text: Sean T. was fantastic.  He helped me design a fantastic seat for my Triumph TR7 restoration.  I brought the seats and a few pics of the car that was in the process of being painted at a different shop.  I wanted bold, and he nailed it.  The pic I am posting is of the passenger seat and the driver's seat can be seen but it is not bolted in just yet.  We chose a black vinyl seat with a hounds tooth black and gold inlay and gold piping.  Everything came out perfect and the seats really make the car pop.  They also met an aggressive timeline to get me the seats just in time for an event where I wanted to show off the car.  I could not be happier.  I highly recommend!

text: We sought the assistance of Sargent’s because we got sunscreen on our brand new leather seats. We were fully prepared to have the leather replaced, and took our vehicle in to get a quote from Jim. Jim told us that he wanted to try and clean it up first. Thankfully what he did worked and we did not have to replace the leather! Jim refused to take payment for the few minutes of wiping and cleaner he put on the leather in our vehicle. We were very appreciative of the fact that he didn’t try to make us replace and pay for something we didn’t need. Jim was very professional and personable, from the phone conversation I had with him to the experience my boyfriend had with him at the business. We will definitely return to Sargent Upholstery for future needs and we highly recommend their services. Thank you Jim, for your help and saving my sanity!!

text:
I purchased the rare 2011 Nissan Murano Cross Cabriolet Covertible in Sept. 2017. July of 2018 someone busted the back window. Unfortunately I had to get the entire cover replaced. It was either Davis Seat Covers or Sargent Upholstry.  I DID NOT have a good customer service experience at Davis and through my insurance claims adjuster was told about Sargent’s.

Words cannot express how awesome Sean is! His service and the service of the company is top notch professional! They have a system set up to text you the amount and you can even communicate within their service system that way. The job done was to perfection.

To add to the story, after putting my top down for the first time in went down but not back up! I took it back to Sean and he worked on it for 2 weeks to no avail. He even took it to the local Nissan, spoke with them.. and they couldn’t help. They finally found that I had to take it to Daytona Nissan as they were the nearest that could do a diagnostic on the top.

When I called Sean he said I could bring it back because he may have the part! He did! Within a couple hours he called me back with the spectacular news! People the cost would have been $3300!!! My insurance would not fix it even though it was working before the accident!

Thank you so much Sean! As I told you!... you’re the BOMB! For as long as I have this car I won’t take it anywhere else!!! His customer service was everything! He really cared and showed that! He worked on my car as if it was his. Very trustworthy! To know the things you have to go through having a convertible... he is truly an expert! They really know what they are doing at Sargent Upholstry! Search no further!

author: Mary Lando
text: Top quality work done at Sargent's! I have had several jobs done here & have been very satisfied with the results. Great customer service as well.

author: Kelly Scott
text:
Brought my H2 for a water leak and they were able to fix issue. Had a problem with it and it was leaking. Turns out it was an unrelated issue that they couldn't fix. They found someone who did fix it and delivered the car to the other vendor and got it back. Clearly they could have told me they didn't handle this and pass me along but instead took it upon themselves to handle it with no monetary gain for themselves.
Sean is a superstar.

author: D MR
text: Sargent Upholstery replaced the headliner of my Mazda. The new headliner looks great and they did a great job of cleaning up my car from this messy process (They have to remove the foam padding under the headliner, which crumbles to dust. This is what causes the headliner to fail.). They were extremely friendly and helpful. Would definitely do business with them again.

author: Justin Rooks
text: Sargent’s did an amazing job replacing a leather seat cover on my 2018 Ford Raptor. Staff was friendly and the turn around was a fraction of what others quoted. Thank you!

author: Ron Hawkins
text: Very fast,excellent work at a very reasonable price.I had the drivers seat done on my Ford F-150 and it looks like it was done at the factory.

author: Dwight Henson
text: Mike was very thorough and informative when I arrived for an estimate to repair the headliner in my Porsche Cayman. The Techs were awesome in that they made sure the material on the headliner matched the rest of the interior. And the quality of their workmanship is second to none... the car was ready when stated and it was clean as well. I'm very pleased with the outcome and recommend their service to anyone. Excellent job guys & gals!

author: Kel
text: Have had the convertible soft top and both leather/vinyl seats redone on a Mazda Miata. Their estimate was the most reasonably priced, timely and always offered in a professional and courteous manner. The uphostlery work they do is the best in Jacksonville, maybe even the southeast. Top rated, quick service, stunning results. The seats look brand new and couldn’t be happy with the work completed at Sargent’s Uphostelry

author: Chriss Mazzarella
text: Had Sargent's make me a new convertible top boot for my 1982 Buick Riviera.  Excellent job good color match and fit. Best of all the car was kept in doors and constantly protected.

author: Tom Hindle
text: Sargent Upholstery met and exceeded my high expectations with the work they did on my 1936 Fiat Topolino. Working with Mike Todd was a pleasant experience, as he is a true professional. Bob, the expert technician who did the actual work,  rebuilt and recovered my original seats and installed carpeting. Everything they did was done perfectly, and I will use this great company again in the future.

author: Renee Favo
text: I found Sargent's to be wonderfully professional, competent, and honest.  Mike quoted me a great price and Bob did an excellent job on my Volvo headliner repair.   I'm a happy customer!  I'm so glad to know about Sargent's.  :)

author: Angelique Goodwin
text: The team at Sargent just finished some beautiful interior work on my 1989 Mercedes SL560. Back in September I contacted Sargent to get some information and estimates for new seats, door panels, and carpet. Mike was extremely helpful providing details on the work involved, timelines, and vendors where I might find the parts for the work. As my car is almost an antique, I really appreciated his guidance and direction. A few weeks ago, I scheduled my appointment and took my car in for the work. They were extremely efficient and helpful through the entire process. When it came time to do the door panels, the company I sourced the specific door leather from had made a mistake. The entire crew (Mike, Bob, Sean) were very helpful in getting pictures taken of the faulty leather and working with me and the vendor in California. The estimate, and final cost, of the work was very reasonable. There is more restoration work I need to do on car, and I will have Sargent do this work for me. Thanks team!

author: Kevin Tyler
text: I have use them three times in the past for boat carpet recently was excellent job cheaper than anywhere else and also leather upholstery repair

author: R Fudge
text: I needed to replace the 2 piece headliner in my truck, so I asked for recommendations from friends and business associates. It was unanimous… Everyone told me to take my truck to Sargent. Sean and Mike were very helpful and took the time to answer all of my questions. I was given a very reasonable estimate of the cost along with the timing to complete the headliner. I’m very glad I took the recommendations of my friends and went to Sargent Upholstery… The headliner is phenomenal! It’s better than factory and exceeded all of my expectations. Sargent Upholstery did an outstanding job! Thank you Mike, Sean and the entire Sargent’s team! I strongly recommend Sargent for anyone in need of upholstery work on their vehicle. A+++++

author: Pete Eldridge
text:
I would STRONGLY suggest using Sargent for anyone looking to get upholstery work done on their vehicle. ..I first came to them to refurbish my Antique motorcycle seat ,and they did a Wonderful job ...tell you the truth it ended up looking better than factory..  !
So when it came to getting work done on my truck I went straight to them....
Mike helped me out ,and not only did they do another Fantastic job , they went above and beyond with their service .
I own a Land Rover and that automatically increases the cost of every repair I get done...but not at Sargent....the price was Very Reasonable and they even fixed an Electrical problem at no charge....
Very Happy with service and will relay to friends to use them....

author: Mark Steiger
text:
Sargent installed headliner and carpet in my 1966 Cortina GT.  8 months later, the 51 year old clips that hold the headliner bows broke.  They were very accommodating to get my car in quickly.  As there are no longer plastic clips for the bows, they used a 3-D printer to custom make the clips, reinstalled the headliner and did an excellent job without additional charge.
This was customer service and professionalism that is unusual these days.

Great job!!

author: Jay Roth
text: Staff did exactly what they said they would in the time they said it would take.  Excellent service and work

author: Teresa H
text: I've had two convertible tops replaced by Sargents for my Toyota Solera.  I've been very happy both times.  The 2nd time I had some issues and Sean took care of it for me, no problem.  I would definitely recommend them.

author: Alexandria Kneeland
text: This place is in a horrible area of town but they do incredible work! My mom's new convertible top is perfect!

author: Les Sutton
text: I have a car business and they have done work for me for many years it's always been consistent and good Quality .If there's ever a problem they usually will take care of it immediately I really like doing business with Mike and the rest of the folks at Sargent.

author: Robert Holladay
text: Just had the leather passenger seat panel (60/40 split) replaced on my F150 Lariat.  PERFECT JOB done in 1 day.  This is the 2nd panel replaced in this truck (Driver seat panel approximately 2 years ago).  They do absolutely beautiful work and get it done when they say they will.  They really care about the results.  I am not connected to Sargent's in any way but I really like their work.  I take all my vehicle upholstery work there.

author: Pete B
text: I had some damaged leather on my Mercedes and Sargent did a beautiful job replacing the damaged panel. The leather matches beautifully and the stitching is perfect.

author: Bruce Damato
text: I took my 2007 Volkswagen convertible to have partial door panels replaced.  They matched the bottom section perfectly with a vinyl top portion.  It looked custom and it was perfect.  All this was done in one day.  I took it to a VW dealer this past weekend and they could not believe the outstanding work.  I would never go to anyone but SERGEANT SEAT COVER CO.

author: Smo King
text: I brought my car in for a seat repair.  The job was perfect.  This is the shop to go to in town.  The owners and the employees are very professional.
